sections.preamble: You are an expert coding assistant operating inside pi, a coding agent harness. You help users by reading files, executing commands, editing code, and writing new files.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- bash: Execute bash commands (ls, grep, find, etc.)
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call
- write: Create or overwrite files
- grep: Search file contents for patterns (respects .gitignore)
- find: Find files by glob pattern (respects .gitignore)
- ls: List directory contents

In addition to the tools above, you may have access to other custom tools depending on the project.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- You can inspect PI_* environment variables for current model and session details.
- Use edit for precise changes (edits[].oldText must match exactly)
- When changing multiple separate locations in one file, use one edit call with multiple entries in edits[] instead of multiple edit calls
- Each edits[].oldText is matched against the original file, not after earlier edits are applied. Do not emit overlapping or nested edits. Merge nearby changes into one edit.
- Keep edits[].oldText as small as possible while still being unique in the file. Do not pad with large unchanged regions.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: bash
toolsAdded.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: grep
toolsAdded.description: Search file contents for a pattern. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 100 matches or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Long lines are truncated to 500 chars.

path.description: Directory or file to search (default: current directory)

glob.description: Filter files by glob pattern, e.g. '*.ts' or '**/*.spec.ts'

literal.description: Treat pattern as literal string instead of regex (default: false)

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default: 100)

toolsAdded.name: find
toolsAdded.description: Search for files by glob pattern. Returns matching file paths relative to the search directory. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 1000 results or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g. '*.ts', '**/*.json', or 'src/**/*.spec.ts'

path.description: Directory to search in (default: current directory)

toolsAdded.name: ls
toolsAdded.description: List directory contents. Returns entries sorted alphabetically, with '/' suffix for directories. Includes dotfiles. Output is truncated to 500 entries or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default: 500)

# КОМПАС-3D: короткий рабочий маршрут

Цель — правильная нативная модель без лишнего исследования. Полные правила безопасности и параметризации из [reference-SKILL.md](reference-SKILL.md) обязательны. Для необычных операций читать нужный раздел; сигнатуры уточнять адресно через `scripts/sdk.py doc`, при ошибке маршалинга — `inspect`/`page`.

## Выбор маршрута

Существующий документ изменять минимально: параметр → эскиз → операция → вхождение → сопряжение. Искать открытый документ по абсолютному пути, затем при необходимости открывать; проверить тип и путь. Не заменять несохранённое состояние дисковой версией.

Для новой детали из ортогональных профилей скопировать самостоятельный [examples/18_orthogonal_profiles.py](examples/18_orthogonal_profiles.py) в `solution.py`, изменить только `SPEC`. Не импортировать скилл как библиотеку, не переписывать механизм связей. Не повторять импорты, обзоры каталогов и нарезку чертежа без конкретной необходимости.

`SPEC`: `profiles` — список `{plane: XOY|XOZ, vertices:[[u,v],...], circles:[[u,v,r],...], depth:signed}`; `bounds:[xmin,ymin,zmin,xmax,ymax,zmax]`; `volume` — мм³. Один замкнутый ортогональный многоугольник на профиль, без соседних коллинеарных рёбер. Окружности строго внутри, без касаний и пересечений; обе координатные разности центра относительно первой вершины ненулевые. Профили объединяются нативными выдавливаниями; окружности оставляют сквозные пустоты в пределах своего профиля. Маршрут проверен для XOY/XOZ и обоих знаков глубины, не для произвольной топологии. Если условия не подходят, выбрать другой нативный рецепт из справочника.

## Геометрический контракт

До кода кратко зафиксировать размеры, базы, оси, подписанные интервалы материала и признак асимметрии по всем видам. Существенно недостающие размеры блокируют соответствующее построение: не угадывать геометрию; выдать доступный результат и назвать ограничение без запроса уточнений.

В правой системе при фронтальном виде с X вправо и Z вверх положительная Y направлена ОТ наблюдателя, не к нему. От отмеченного начала вывести подписанные интервалы, затем глубины; не выбирать знак по привычному экранному виду.

В указанном рецепте XOY: `(u,v)=(X,Y)`, глубина вдоль Z; XOZ: `(u,v)=(X,-Z)`, глубина вдоль Y. Согласовать ОБЕ настройки: `SetDirection(dtNormal if depth>0 else dtReverse)` и `SetSideParameters(depth>0, etBlind, abs(depth), 0, False, None)`. Не переносить эту семантику на другие операции.

Ожидаемые границы выводить из чертежа, не из первого запуска. При заданных начале и стороне проверка фактических минимумов/максимумов и признака асимметрии ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНА, даже если общий маршрут допускает проверку только объёма: объём и размеры коробки отражение не исключают. При расхождении диагностировать конкретную настройку, не перебирать знаки и не подгонять ожидания.

## Выполнение и приёмка

Только существующая сессия через `ksapi.GetKompas()`; CAD не запускать и не перезапускать. Один CAD-писатель, без параллельного API-инспектора. Сохранять нативные управляющие размеры и связи; тотальная фиксация не заменяет параметризацию.

Запуск: `bash skill/scripts/run.sh solution.py --output ABS_NEW_PATH`. Не скрывать код завершения конвейером; при конвейере сохранить статус макроса. Проверить ошибки затронутых операций, нужный геометрический признак и заданный объём; без причины не добавлять полный аудит, reopen или тест изменения размеров.

После правки кода или ожиданий заново выполнить итоговый исходник в новый выходной каталог. Выдавать только модель из этого успешного запуска; комментарии и assertions не исправляют прежний артефакт.

Все новые выходы проверять на отсутствие до построения и перед записью; не удалять и не перезаписывать файлы ради обхода диалога. Закрывать только собственные документы, одним владельцем, не более одного раза. При неизвестном исходе нативного вызова прекратить ВСЕ API-вызовы, включая cleanup; сохранить этап и ошибку, не повторять запись вслепую. Кратко сообщить фактический результат и ограничения.

# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.11"
# dependencies = []
# ///
"""Native dimension-driven orthogonal profiles on XOY/XOZ, with signed extrusion.

Copy this standalone recipe and set SPEC, or pass --spec part.json --output part.m3d.
Coordinates are sketch-local: native XOZ maps (u,v) to (X,0,-Z).
Each profile has vertices, optional circles [u,v,r], plane, and signed depth.
One vertex anchors each polygon; lengths, coincidences and H/V drive its shape.
Circle positions are dimensioned from the anchor; circles on its axes are not
supported by this recipe. Nonorthogonal polygons require another recipe.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import ksapi
from constants import constants as c
from constants3d import constants as c3d

SPEC: dict[str, Any] = {}


def require(value: Any, label: str) -> Any:
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError(label)
    return value


def constraint(obj: Any, kind: int, **values: Any) -> None:
    item = require(obj.NewConstraint(), "NewConstraint")
    item.SetConstraintType(kind)
    for key, value in values.items():
        getattr(item, "Set" + key)(value)
    require(item.Create() and item.IsValid(), f"Constraint {kind}")


def drive(dim: Any, name: str, value: float) -> None:
    constraint(dim, c.ksCFixedDim)
    constraint(dim, c.ksCDimWithVariable, Variable=name, ConstraintValue=value)


def length(symbols: Any, p: list[float], q: list[float], horizontal: bool,
           name: str) -> None:
    axis = 0 if horizontal else 1
    value = abs(q[axis] - p[axis])
    require(value > 1e-7, "Zero driving dimension")
    dim = require(symbols.GetLineDimensions().Add(), "Dimension")
    dim.SetX1(p[0]); dim.SetY1(p[1])
    dim.SetX2(q[0]); dim.SetY2(q[1])
    dim.SetX3((p[0] + q[0]) / 2 + (0 if horizontal else -7))
    dim.SetY3((p[1] + q[1]) / 2 + (-7 if horizontal else 0))
    dim.SetOrientation(c.ksLinDHorizontal if horizontal else c.ksLinDVertical)
    require(dim.Update() and dim.Associate(), f"Dimension association {name}")
    drive(dim, name, value)


def profile(part: Any, model: Any, spec: dict[str, Any], index: int) -> Any:
    points = spec["vertices"]
    require(len(points) >= 4, "Polygon needs four vertices")
    edges = list(zip(points, points[1:] + points[:1]))
    directions = []
    for p, q in edges:
        dx, dy = q[0] - p[0], q[1] - p[1]
        require((abs(dx) < 1e-9) != (abs(dy) < 1e-9), "Nonorthogonal or zero edge")
        directions.append(abs(dy) < 1e-9)
    require(all(directions[i] != directions[(i + 1) % len(edges)]
                for i in range(len(edges))), "Merge adjacent collinear edges first")
    plane = {"XOY": c3d.o3d_planeXOY, "XOZ": c3d.o3d_planeXOZ}[spec["plane"]]
    sketch = require(model.GetSketchs().Add(), "Sketch")
    sketch.SetName(spec.get("name", f"Profile {index}"))
    sketch.SetPlane(require(part.GetDefaultObject(plane), "Plane"))
    require(sketch.Update(), "Sketch Update")
    fragment = require(sketch.BeginEdit(False), "BeginEdit")
    fragment.SetParametricMode(True)
    view = require(fragment.GetViewsAndLayersManager().GetViews().GetActiveView(), "View")
    drawing, symbols = ksapi.IDrawingContainer(view), ksapi.ISymbols2DContainer(view)
    lines = []
    for p, q in edges:
        line = require(drawing.GetLineSegments().Add(), "Line")
        line.SetX1(p[0]); line.SetY1(p[1]); line.SetX2(q[0]); line.SetY2(q[1])
        require(line.Update(), "Line Update")
        lines.append(line)
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        constraint(line, c.ksCMergePoints, Partners=[lines[(i + 1) % len(lines)]],
                   Index=1, PartnerIndex=0)
        constraint(line, c.ksCHorizontal if directions[i] else c.ksCVertical)
    constraint(lines[0], c.ksCFixedPoint, Index=0)
    # Closure supplies the last horizontal and vertical lengths: do not overconstrain.
    skip = {max(i for i, h in enumerate(directions) if h),
            max(i for i, h in enumerate(directions) if not h)}
    for i, (p, q) in enumerate(edges):
        if i not in skip:
            length(symbols, p, q, directions[i], f"p{index}_e{i}")
    for j, (x, y, radius) in enumerate(spec.get("circles", [])):
        circle = require(drawing.GetCircles().Add(), "Circle")
        circle.SetXc(x); circle.SetYc(y); circle.SetRadius(radius)
        require(circle.Update(), "Circle Update")
        length(symbols, points[0], [x, y], True, f"p{index}_c{j}_x")
        length(symbols, points[0], [x, y], False, f"p{index}_c{j}_y")
        dim = require(symbols.GetRadialDimensions().Add(), "Radius")
        dim.SetBaseObject(circle); dim.SetXc(x); dim.SetYc(y)
        dim.SetRadius(radius); dim.SetAngle(35.)
        require(dim.Update(), "Radius Update")
        drive(dim, f"p{index}_c{j}_r", radius)
    require(sketch.EndEdit(), "EndEdit")
    require(sketch.GetConstraintsState() == c.ksStateWellConstrained, "Underdefined sketch")
    depth = spec["depth"]
    require(math.isfinite(depth) and depth != 0, "Invalid signed depth")
    normal = depth > 0
    operation = require(model.GetExtrusions().Add(c3d.o3d_bossExtrusion), "Extrusion")
    operation.SetProfiles([sketch])
    operation.SetDirection(c3d.dtNormal if normal else c3d.dtReverse)
    require(operation.SetSideParameters(normal, c3d.etBlind, abs(depth), 0., False, None), "Depth")
    require(operation.Update(), "Extrusion Update")
    require(not ksapi.IFeature(operation).GetObjectError(), "Extrusion error")
    return sketch


def build(spec: dict[str, Any], output: Path | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if output is not None:
        require(not output.exists() and not output.is_symlink(), "Output exists")
    app = require(ksapi.GetKompas(), "No existing CAD session")
    previous = app.GetActiveDocument()
    doc = require(app.GetDocuments().AddWithDefaultSettings(c.ksDocumentPart, True), "New part")
    # No cleanup after an interrupted/failed native call: session outcome is unknown.
    try:
        part = require(ksapi.IKompasDocument3D(doc).GetTopPart(), "Part")
        model = require(part.GetModelContainer(), "Model")
        sketches = [profile(part, model, item, i) for i, item in enumerate(spec["profiles"])]
        require(part.RebuildModel(True), "Rebuild")
        bodies = ksapi.IFeature(part).GetResultBodies()
        require(len(bodies) == 1 and bodies[0].IsSolid(), "Expected one solid")
        raw = bodies[0].GetGabarit(0., 0., 0., 0., 0., 0.)
        require(raw[0], "Bounds status")
        bounds = list(raw[1:])
        require(all(abs(a - b) < 1e-5 for a, b in zip(bounds, spec["bounds"])),
                f"Signed bounds {bounds} != {spec['bounds']}")
        mass = require(ksapi.IMassInertiaParam(part), "Mass")
        mass.SetLengthUnits(c.ksLUnMM)
        require(mass.Calculate(), "Mass calculation")
        volume = mass.GetVolume()
        require(abs(volume - spec["volume"]) < .5, f"Volume {volume}")
        require(all(s.GetConstraintsState() == c.ksStateWellConstrained for s in sketches), "Sketch state")
        if output is not None:
            require(not output.exists() and not output.is_symlink(), "Output exists before save")
            require(doc.SaveAs(str(output)), "SaveAs")
            require(output.is_file() and output.stat().st_size > 0, "Missing output")
        result = {"bounds": bounds, "volume": volume, "sketches": len(sketches)}
    except BaseException:
        # Preserve stage/traceback and suspect document rather than further API calls.
        raise
    require(doc.Close(c.kdDoNotSaveChanges), "Close own document")
    if previous:
        previous.SetActive()
    return result


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--spec", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--qualify", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.qualify:
        for plane, sign in (("XOY", 1), ("XOY", -1), ("XOZ", 1), ("XOZ", -1)):
            low, high = sorted([0., sign * 6.])
            bounds = ([0., 0., low, 43., 27., high] if plane == "XOY" else
                      [0., low, -27., 43., high, 0.])
            spec = {"profiles": [{"plane": plane, "vertices": [[0, 0], [43, 0], [43, 27], [0, 27]],
                                  "circles": [[11, 9, 3.5]], "depth": sign * 6}],
                    "bounds": bounds, "volume": (43 * 27 - math.pi * 3.5 ** 2) * 6}
            print(json.dumps({"plane": plane, "sign": sign, **build(spec, None)}), flush=True)
        spec = {"profiles": [
            {"plane": "XOZ", "vertices": [[0, 0], [47, 0], [47, -19], [0, -19]],
             "circles": [[13, -8, 2.5]], "depth": -17},
            {"plane": "XOZ", "vertices": [[0, -19], [35, -19], [35, -26], [22, -26],
                                             [22, -39], [9, -39], [9, -53], [0, -53]], "depth": -11}],
                "bounds": [0, -17, 0, 47, 0, 53],
                "volume": (47 * 19 - math.pi * 2.5 ** 2) * 17 + (35 * 7 + 22 * 13 + 9 * 14) * 11}
        print(json.dumps({"qualification": "two signed profiles and negative local coordinates",
                          **build(spec, None)}), flush=True)
    else:
        spec = json.loads(args.spec.read_text()) if args.spec else SPEC
        require(spec, "Set SPEC or pass --spec")
        require(args.output, "Pass --output")
        print(json.dumps(build(spec, args.output.resolve())), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    doc = require(app.GetDocuments().AddWithDefaultSettings(c.ksDocumentPart, True), "New part")
    # No cleanup after an interrupted/failed native call: session outcome is unknown.
    try:
        part = require(ksapi.IKompasDocument3D(doc).GetTopPart(), "Part")
        model = require(part.GetModelContainer(), "Model")
        sketches = [profile(part, model, item, i) for i, item in enumerate(spec["profiles"])]
        require(part.RebuildModel(True), "Rebuild")
        bodies = ksapi.IFeature(part).GetResultBodies()
        require(len(bodies) == 1 and bodies[0].IsSolid(), "Expected one solid")
        raw = bodies[0].GetGabarit(0., 0., 0., 0., 0., 0.)
        require(raw[0], "Bounds status")
        bounds = list(raw[1:])
        require(all(abs(a - b) < 1e-5 for a, b in zip(bounds, spec["bounds"])),
                f"Signed bounds {bounds} != {spec['bounds']}")
        mass = require(ksapi.IMassInertiaParam(part), "Mass")
        mass.SetLengthUnits(c.ksLUnMM)
        require(mass.Calculate(), "Mass calculation")
        volume = mass.GetVolume()
        require(abs(volume - spec["volume"]) < .5, f"Volume {volume}")
        require(all(s.GetConstraintsState() == c.ksStateWellConstrained for s in sketches), "Sketch state")
        if output is not None:
            require(not output.exists() and not output.is_symlink(), "Output exists before save")
            require(doc.SaveAs(str(output)), "SaveAs")
            require(output.is_file() and output.stat().st_size > 0, "Missing output")
        result = {"bounds": bounds, "volume": volume, "sketches": len(sketches)}
    except BaseException:
        # Preserve stage/traceback and suspect document rather than further API calls.
        raise
    require(doc.Close(c.kdDoNotSaveChanges), "Close own document")
    if previous:
        previous.SetActive()
    return result


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--spec", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--qualify", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.qualify:
        for plane, sign in (("XOY", 1), ("XOY", -1), ("XOZ", 1), ("XOZ", -1)):
            low, high = sorted([0., sign * 6.])
            bounds = ([0., 0., low, 43., 27., high] if plane == "XOY" else
                      [0., low, -27., 43., high, 0.])
            spec = {"profiles": [{"plane": plane, "vertices": [[0, 0], [43, 0], [43, 27], [0, 27]],
                                  "circles": [[11, 9, 3.5]], "depth": sign * 6}],
                    "bounds": bounds, "volume": (43 * 27 - math.pi * 3.5 ** 2) * 6}
            print(json.dumps({"plane": plane, "sign": sign, **build(spec, None)}), flush=True)
        spec = {"profiles": [
            {"plane": "XOZ", "vertices": [[0, 0], [47, 0], [47, -19], [0, -19]],
             "circles": [[13, -8, 2.5]], "depth": -17},
            {"plane": "XOZ", "vertices": [[0, -19], [35, -19], [35, -26], [22, -26],
                                             [22, -39], [9, -39], [9, -53], [0, -53]], "depth": -11}],
                "bounds": [0, -17, 0, 47, 0, 53],
                "volume": (47 * 19 - math.pi * 2.5 ** 2) * 17 + (35 * 7 + 22 * 13 + 9 * 14) * 11}
        print(json.dumps({"qualification": "two signed profiles and negative local coordinates",
                          **build(spec, None)}), flush=True)
    else:
        spec = json.loads(args.spec.read_text()) if args.spec else SPEC
        require(spec, "Set SPEC or pass --spec")
        require(args.output, "Pass --output")
        print(json.dumps(build(spec, args.output.resolve())), flush=True)

# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.11"
# dependencies = []
# ///
"""Practice Problem 1.1 - stepped block with through hole.

Origin at the left/front/bottom corner of the base block (red marker).
Front view: X right, Z up.  Top view: X right, Y away from viewer.
Positive Y points away from the viewer, so the exposed ledge of the base
top face (depth 8) lies at Y = 0..8 and the stacked steps occupy Y = 8..28.

Signed material intervals (mm):
  base   X 0..60  Y 0..28  Z  0..30   with O12 through hole along Y at (44, 16)
  step 1 X 0..48  Y 8..28  Z 30..38
  step 2 X 0..32  Y 8..28  Z 38..50
  column X 0..20  Y 8..28  Z 50..75

All four profiles are XOY rectangles extruded in +Z; the union is exact
because every upper footprint is contained in the base footprint.
Bounding box is asymmetric in X and Z (0..60, 0..28, 0..75).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import ksapi
from constants import constants as c
from constants3d import constants as c3d

SPEC: dict[str, Any] = {
    "profiles": [
        {
            "name": "Base 60x28x30",
            "plane": "XOY",
            "vertices": [[0, 0], [60, 0], [60, 28], [0, 28]],
            "circles": [[44, 16, 6]],
            "depth": 30,
        },
        {
            "name": "Step 48 wide to Z38",
            "plane": "XOY",
            "vertices": [[0, 8], [48, 8], [48, 28], [0, 28]],
            "depth": 38,
        },
        {
            "name": "Step 32 wide to Z50",
            "plane": "XOY",
            "vertices": [[0, 8], [32, 8], [32, 28], [0, 28]],
            "depth": 50,
        },
        {
            "name": "Column 20 wide to Z75",
            "plane": "XOY",
            "vertices": [[0, 8], [20, 8], [20, 28], [0, 28]],
            "depth": 75,
        },
    ],
    "bounds": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 60.0, 28.0, 75.0],
    "volume": 72593.27460518149,
}


def require(value: Any, label: str) -> Any:
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError(label)
    return value


def constraint(obj: Any, kind: int, **values: Any) -> None:
    item = require(obj.NewConstraint(), "NewConstraint")
    item.SetConstraintType(kind)
    for key, value in values.items():
        getattr(item, "Set" + key)(value)
    require(item.Create() and item.IsValid(), f"Constraint {kind}")


def drive(dim: Any, name: str, value: float) -> None:
    constraint(dim, c.ksCFixedDim)
    constraint(dim, c.ksCDimWithVariable, Variable=name, ConstraintValue=value)


def length(symbols: Any, p: list[float], q: list[float], horizontal: bool,
           name: str) -> None:
    axis = 0 if horizontal else 1
    value = abs(q[axis] - p[axis])
    require(value > 1e-7, "Zero driving dimension")
    dim = require(symbols.GetLineDimensions().Add(), "Dimension")
    dim.SetX1(p[0]); dim.SetY1(p[1])
    dim.SetX2(q[0]); dim.SetY2(q[1])
    dim.SetX3((p[0] + q[0]) / 2 + (0 if horizontal else -7))
    dim.SetY3((p[1] + q[1]) / 2 + (-7 if horizontal else 0))
    dim.SetOrientation(c.ksLinDHorizontal if horizontal else c.ksLinDVertical)
    require(dim.Update() and dim.Associate(), f"Dimension association {name}")
    drive(dim, name, value)


def profile(part: Any, model: Any, spec: dict[str, Any], index: int) -> Any:
    points = spec["vertices"]
    require(len(points) >= 4, "Polygon needs four vertices")
    edges = list(zip(points, points[1:] + points[:1]))
    directions = []
    for p, q in edges:
        dx, dy = q[0] - p[0], q[1] - p[1]
        require((abs(dx) < 1e-9) != (abs(dy) < 1e-9), "Nonorthogonal or zero edge")
        directions.append(abs(dy) < 1e-9)
    require(all(directions[i] != directions[(i + 1) % len(edges)]
                for i in range(len(edges))), "Merge adjacent collinear edges first")
    plane = {"XOY": c3d.o3d_planeXOY, "XOZ": c3d.o3d_planeXOZ}[spec["plane"]]
    sketch = require(model.GetSketchs().Add(), "Sketch")
    sketch.SetName(spec.get("name", f"Profile {index}"))
    sketch.SetPlane(require(part.GetDefaultObject(plane), "Plane"))
    require(sketch.Update(), "Sketch Update")
    fragment = require(sketch.BeginEdit(False), "BeginEdit")
    fragment.SetParametricMode(True)
    view = require(fragment.GetViewsAndLayersManager().GetViews().GetActiveView(), "View")
    drawing, symbols = ksapi.IDrawingContainer(view), ksapi.ISymbols2DContainer(view)
    lines = []
    for p, q in edges:
        line = require(drawing.GetLineSegments().Add(), "Line")
        line.SetX1(p[0]); line.SetY1(p[1]); line.SetX2(q[0]); line.SetY2(q[1])
        require(line.Update(), "Line Update")
        lines.append(line)
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        constraint(line, c.ksCMergePoints, Partners=[lines[(i + 1) % len(lines)]],
                   Index=1, PartnerIndex=0)
        constraint(line, c.ksCHorizontal if directions[i] else c.ksCVertical)
    constraint(lines[0], c.ksCFixedPoint, Index=0)
    # Closure supplies the last horizontal and vertical lengths: do not overconstrain.
    skip = {max(i for i, h in enumerate(directions) if h),
            max(i for i, h in enumerate(directions) if not h)}
    for i, (p, q) in enumerate(edges):
        if i not in skip:
            length(symbols, p, q, directions[i], f"p{index}_e{i}")
    for j, (x, y, radius) in enumerate(spec.get("circles", [])):
        circle = require(drawing.GetCircles().Add(), "Circle")
        circle.SetXc(x); circle.SetYc(y); circle.SetRadius(radius)
        require(circle.Update(), "Circle Update")
        length(symbols, points[0], [x, y], True, f"p{index}_c{j}_x")
        length(symbols, points[0], [x, y], False, f"p{index}_c{j}_y")
        dim = require(symbols.GetRadialDimensions().Add(), "Radius")
        dim.SetBaseObject(circle); dim.SetXc(x); dim.SetYc(y)
        dim.SetRadius(radius); dim.SetAngle(35.)
        require(dim.Update(), "Radius Update")
        drive(dim, f"p{index}_c{j}_r", radius)
    require(sketch.EndEdit(), "EndEdit")
    require(sketch.GetConstraintsState() == c.ksStateWellConstrained, "Underdefined sketch")
    depth = spec["depth"]
    require(math.isfinite(depth) and depth != 0, "Invalid signed depth")
    normal = depth > 0
    operation = require(model.GetExtrusions().Add(c3d.o3d_bossExtrusion), "Extrusion")
    operation.SetProfiles([sketch])
    operation.SetDirection(c3d.dtNormal if normal else c3d.dtReverse)
    require(operation.SetSideParameters(normal, c3d.etBlind, abs(depth), 0., False, None), "Depth")
    require(operation.Update(), "Extrusion Update")
    require(not ksapi.IFeature(operation).GetObjectError(), "Extrusion error")
    return sketch


def build(spec: dict[str, Any], output: Path | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if output is not None:
        require(not output.exists() and not output.is_symlink(), "Output exists")
    app = require(ksapi.GetKompas(), "No existing CAD session")
    previous = app.GetActiveDocument()
    doc = require(app.GetDocuments().AddWithDefaultSettings(c.ksDocumentPart, True), "New part")
    # No cleanup after an interrupted/failed native call: session outcome is unknown.
    try:
        part = require(ksapi.IKompasDocument3D(doc).GetTopPart(), "Part")
        model = require(part.GetModelContainer(), "Model")
        sketches = [profile(part, model, item, i) for i, item in enumerate(spec["profiles"])]
        require(part.RebuildModel(True), "Rebuild")
        bodies = ksapi.IFeature(part).GetResultBodies()
        require(len(bodies) == 1 and bodies[0].IsSolid(), "Expected one solid")
        raw = bodies[0].GetGabarit(0., 0., 0., 0., 0., 0.)
        require(raw[0], "Bounds status")
        bounds = list(raw[1:])
        require(all(abs(a - b) < 1e-5 for a, b in zip(bounds, spec["bounds"])),
                f"Signed bounds {bounds} != {spec['bounds']}")
        mass = require(ksapi.IMassInertiaParam(part), "Mass")
        mass.SetLengthUnits(c.ksLUnMM)
        require(mass.Calculate(), "Mass calculation")
        volume = mass.GetVolume()
        require(abs(volume - spec["volume"]) < .5, f"Volume {volume}")
        require(all(s.GetConstraintsState() == c.ksStateWellConstrained for s in sketches), "Sketch state")
        if output is not None:
            require(not output.exists() and not output.is_symlink(), "Output exists before save")
            require(doc.SaveAs(str(output)), "SaveAs")
            require(output.is_file() and output.stat().st_size > 0, "Missing output")
        result = {"bounds": bounds, "volume": volume, "sketches": len(sketches)}
    except BaseException:
        # Preserve stage/traceback and suspect document rather than further API calls.
        raise
    require(doc.Close(c.kdDoNotSaveChanges), "Close own document")
    if previous:
        previous.SetActive()
    return result


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--spec", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--qualify", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.qualify:
        raise SystemExit("qualification not used for this task")
    spec = json.loads(args.spec.read_text()) if args.spec else SPEC
    require(spec, "Set SPEC or pass --spec")
    require(args.output, "Pass --output")
    print(json.dumps(build(spec, args.output.resolve())), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

For XOZ, `(u,v)=(X,-Z)`, depth along Y, with `depth>0` → direction normal (+Y). Steps span Y 8..28. The recipe's extrusion starts at the sketch plane (Y=0) and goes to depth. So start at Y=0 and depth +28, then the shape needs to be built so it only claims material at Y 8..28 — but the sketch profile is in XOZ, so the extrusion covers X-Z shape × full Y. I can't make a Y-offset directly with a plain sketch plane.

Better: put the sketch on an XOZ-parallel plane offset in Y. But the recipe sets `SetPlane` to a default plane only. Simplest alternative: use XOY profiles for everything.

  - Step2: rect (0,8)-(32,28) depth +50. Union → adds Z 38..50 over that footprint ✓
  - Column: rect (0,8)-(20,28) depth +75 ✓

All XOY, all positive depth. This is clean and matches the recipe exactly.

Bounds: X 0..60, Y 0..28, Z 0..75.

Note the XOZ carrier's rectangle is coincident with the base's X-Z silhouette, and its extrusion direction `depth>0` → `dtNormal` +Y from the Y=0 plane. If Kompas's XOZ normal points in -Y, the extrusion went to Y -28..0, entirely outside the base — adding a separate solid... but then we'd get 2 bodies, and bounds would show Y -28. Bounds passed (0..28). So it must have gone +Y and simply merged with no cut.

More likely: the circle in a profile only creates a hole in that profile's own extrusion; when unioned with the base which already fills that region, the hole is filled back in. The union is commutative geometrically: the carrier solid (with hole) ∪ base = base (hole filled). That's the issue.

So I need the hole cut as a genuine cut after the base is built, or the base itself must be extruded along Y. Better approach: build the base as an **XOZ** profile (X, -Z) rectangle with the circle, depth +28 along Y. That makes the hole native to the base's own extrusion. content.text:
75760 = full sum with **no hole** at all. So the XOZ extrusion added no material (good) but its circle cut nothing either. Likely the XOZ profile extrusion direction/side put it outside the part, or the circle in that profile isn't cut as a hole.

Note the XOZ carrier's rectangle is coincident with the base's X-Z silhouette, and its extrusion direction `depth>0` → `dtNormal` +Y from the Y=0 plane. If Kompas's XOZ normal points in -Y, the extrusion went to Y -28..0, entirely outside the base — adding a separate solid... but then we'd get 2 bodies, and bounds would show Y -28. Bounds passed (0..28). So it must have gone +Y and simply merged with no cut.

More likely: the circle in a profile only creates a hole in that profile's own extrusion; when unioned with the base which already fills that region, the hole is filled back in. The union is commutative geometrically: the carrier solid (with hole) ∪ base = base (hole filled). That's the issue.

So I need the hole cut as a genuine cut after the base is built, or the base itself must be extruded along Y. Better approach: build the base as an **XOZ** profile (X, -Z) rectangle with the circle, depth +28 along Y. That makes the hole native to the base's own extrusion. Then the three steps as XOY rects extruded +Z (they sit above Z=30, unaffected).

Let me restructure: base = XOZ profile (X 0..60, v 0..-30) with circle at (44,-16,r6), depth 28.

Expected: base volume = 60*30*28 - π*36*28 = 50400 - 3166.73 = 47233.27 ✓. Plus steps = 72593.27 ✓.

def build(part: ksapi.IPart, model: ksapi.IModelContainer) -> None:
    auxiliary = require(ksapi.IAuxiliaryGeomContainer(part), "Auxiliary geometry")
    plane = require(auxiliary.GetPlanes3D().Add(c3d.o3d_planeOffset), "Offset plane")
    offset = require(ksapi.IPlane3DByOffset(plane), "Offset-plane interface")
    offset.SetBasePlane(require(part.GetDefaultObject(c3d.o3d_planeXOY), "XOY plane"))
    offset.SetOffset(15.0)
    offset.SetDirection(True)
    require(offset.Update(), "Offset plane at Z=15")
    with edit_sketch(model, plane) as (profile, drawing):
        circle = require(drawing.GetCircles().Add(), "Circle")
        circle.SetXc(0.0)
        circle.SetYc(0.0)
        circle.SetRadius(5.0)
        require(circle.Update(), "Circle geometry")

    extrusion = require(model.GetExtrusions().Add(c3d.o3d_bossExtrusion), "Extrusion")
    extrusion.SetProfiles([profile])
    extrusion.SetDirection(c3d.dtNormal)
    require(extrusion.SetSideParameters(True, c3d.etBlind, 5.0, 0.0, False, None), "Depth")
    require(extrusion.Update(), "Build cylinder")


def validate(part: ksapi.IPart) -> Bounds:
    require(part.RebuildModel(True), "Rebuild part")
    root = require(ksapi.IFeature(part), "Part feature")
    errors, seen = [], set()

    def visit(feature: ksapi.IFeature, path: Sequence[str]) -> None:
        if feature.reference in seen:
            return
        seen.add(feature.reference)
        path = [*path, feature.GetName()]
        error = feature.GetObjectError()
        if error:
            errors.append((path, error))

# КОМПАС-3D: короткий рабочий маршрут

Цель — правильная нативная модель без лишнего исследования. Полные правила безопасности и параметризации из [reference-SKILL.md](reference-SKILL.md) обязательны. Для необычных операций читать нужный раздел; сигнатуры уточнять адресно через `scripts/sdk.py doc`, при ошибке маршалинга — `inspect`/`page`.

## Выбор маршрута

Существующий документ изменять минимально: параметр → эскиз → операция → вхождение → сопряжение. Искать открытый документ по абсолютному пути, затем при необходимости открывать; проверить тип и путь. Не заменять несохранённое состояние дисковой версией.

Для новой детали из ортогональных профилей скопировать самостоятельный [examples/18_orthogonal_profiles.py](examples/18_orthogonal_profiles.py) в `solution.py`, изменить только `SPEC`. Не импортировать скилл как библиотеку, не переписывать механизм связей. Не повторять импорты, обзоры каталогов и нарезку чертежа без конкретной необходимости.

`SPEC`: `profiles` — список `{plane: XOY|XOZ, vertices:[[u,v],...], circles:[[u,v,r],...], depth:signed}`; `bounds:[xmin,ymin,zmin,xmax,ymax,zmax]`; `volume` — мм³. Один замкнутый ортогональный многоугольник на профиль, без соседних коллинеарных рёбер. Окружности строго внутри, без касаний и пересечений; обе координатные разности центра относительно первой вершины ненулевые. Профили объединяются нативными выдавливаниями; окружности оставляют сквозные пустоты в пределах своего профиля. Маршрут проверен для XOY/XOZ и обоих знаков глубины, не для произвольной топологии. Если условия не подходят, выбрать другой нативный рецепт из справочника.

## Геометрический контракт

До кода кратко зафиксировать размеры, базы, оси, подписанные интервалы материала и признак асимметрии по всем видам. Существенно недостающие размеры блокируют соответствующее построение: не угадывать геометрию; выдать доступный результат и назвать ограничение без запроса уточнений.

В правой системе при фронтальном виде с X вправо и Z вверх положительная Y направлена ОТ наблюдателя, не к нему. От отмеченного начала вывести подписанные интервалы, затем глубины; не выбирать знак по привычному экранному виду.

В указанном рецепте XOY: `(u,v)=(X,Y)`, глубина вдоль Z; XOZ: `(u,v)=(X,-Z)`, глубина вдоль Y. Согласовать ОБЕ настройки: `SetDirection(dtNormal if depth>0 else dtReverse)` и `SetSideParameters(depth>0, etBlind, abs(depth), 0, False, None)`. Не переносить эту семантику на другие операции.

Ожидаемые границы выводить из чертежа, не из первого запуска. При заданных начале и стороне проверка фактических минимумов/максимумов и признака асимметрии ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНА, даже если общий маршрут допускает проверку только объёма: объём и размеры коробки отражение не исключают. При расхождении диагностировать конкретную настройку, не перебирать знаки и не подгонять ожидания.

## Выполнение и приёмка

Только существующая сессия через `ksapi.GetKompas()`; CAD не запускать и не перезапускать. Один CAD-писатель, без параллельного API-инспектора. Сохранять нативные управляющие размеры и связи; тотальная фиксация не заменяет параметризацию.

# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.11"
# dependencies = []
# ///
"""Native dimension-driven orthogonal profiles on XOY/XOZ, with signed extrusion.

Copy this standalone recipe and set SPEC, or pass --spec part.json --output part.m3d.
Coordinates are sketch-local: native XOZ maps (u,v) to (X,0,-Z).
Each profile has vertices, optional circles [u,v,r], plane, and signed depth.
One vertex anchors each polygon; lengths, coincidences and H/V drive its shape.
Circle positions are dimensioned from the anchor; circles on its axes are not
supported by this recipe. Nonorthogonal polygons require another recipe.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import ksapi
from constants import constants as c
from constants3d import constants as c3d

SPEC: dict[str, Any] = {}


def require(value: Any, label: str) -> Any:
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError(label)
    return value


def constraint(obj: Any, kind: int, **values: Any) -> None:
    item = require(obj.NewConstraint(), "NewConstraint")
    item.SetConstraintType(kind)
    for key, value in values.items():
        getattr(item, "Set" + key)(value)
    require(item.Create() and item.IsValid(), f"Constraint {kind}")


def drive(dim: Any, name: str, value: float) -> None:
    constraint(dim, c.ksCFixedDim)
    constraint(dim, c.ksCDimWithVariable, Variable=name, ConstraintValue=value)


def length(symbols: Any, p: list[float], q: list[float], horizontal: bool,
           name: str) -> None:
    axis = 0 if horizontal else 1
    value = abs(q[axis] - p[axis])
    require(value > 1e-7, "Zero driving dimension")
    dim = require(symbols.GetLineDimensions().Add(), "Dimension")
    dim.SetX1(p[0]); dim.SetY1(p[1])
    dim.SetX2(q[0]); dim.SetY2(q[1])
    dim.SetX3((p[0] + q[0]) / 2 + (0 if horizontal else -7))
    dim.SetY3((p[1] + q[1]) / 2 + (-7 if horizontal else 0))
    dim.SetOrientation(c.ksLinDHorizontal if horizontal else c.ksLinDVertical)
    require(dim.Update() and dim.Associate(), f"Dimension association {name}")
    drive(dim, name, value)


def profile(part: Any, model: Any, spec: dict[str, Any], index: int) -> Any:
    points = spec["vertices"]
    require(len(points) >= 4, "Polygon needs four vertices")
    edges = list(zip(points, points[1:] + points[:1]))
    directions = []
    for p, q in edges:
        dx, dy = q[0] - p[0], q[1] - p[1]
        require((abs(dx) < 1e-9) != (abs(dy) < 1e-9), "Nonorthogonal or zero edge")
        directions.append(abs(dy) < 1e-9)
    require(all(directions[i] != directions[(i + 1) % len(edges)]
                for i in range(len(edges))), "Merge adjacent collinear edges first")
    plane = {"XOY": c3d.o3d_planeXOY, "XOZ": c3d.o3d_planeXOZ}[spec["plane"]]
    sketch = require(model.GetSketchs().Add(), "Sketch")
    sketch.SetName(spec.get("name", f"Profile {index}"))
    sketch.SetPlane(require(part.GetDefaultObject(plane), "Plane"))
    require(sketch.Update(), "Sketch Update")
    fragment = require(sketch.BeginEdit(False), "BeginEdit")
    fragment.SetParametricMode(True)
    view = require(fragment.GetViewsAndLayersManager().GetViews().GetActiveView(), "View")
    drawing, symbols = ksapi.IDrawingContainer(view), ksapi.ISymbols2DContainer(view)
    lines = []
    for p, q in edges:
        line = require(drawing.GetLineSegments().Add(), "Line")
        line.SetX1(p[0]); line.SetY1(p[1]); line.SetX2(q[0]); line.SetY2(q[1])
        require(line.Update(), "Line Update")
        lines.append(line)
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        constraint(line, c.ksCMergePoints, Partners=[lines[(i + 1) % len(lines)]],
                   Index=1, PartnerIndex=0)
        constraint(line, c.ksCHorizontal if directions[i] else c.ksCVertical)
    constraint(lines[0], c.ksCFixedPoint, Index=0)
    # Closure supplies the last horizontal and vertical lengths: do not overconstrain.
    skip = {max(i for i, h in enumerate(directions) if h),
            max(i for i, h in enumerate(directions) if not h)}
    for i, (p, q) in enumerate(edges):
        if i not in skip:
            length(symbols, p, q, directions[i], f"p{index}_e{i}")
    for j, (x, y, radius) in enumerate(spec.get("circles", [])):
        circle = require(drawing.GetCircles().Add(), "Circle")
        circle.SetXc(x); circle.SetYc(y); circle.SetRadius(radius)
        require(circle.Update(), "Circle Update")
        length(symbols, points[0], [x, y], True, f"p{index}_c{j}_x")
        length(symbols, points[0], [x, y], False, f"p{index}_c{j}_y")
        dim = require(symbols.GetRadialDimensions().Add(), "Radius")
        dim.SetBaseObject(circle); dim.SetXc(x); dim.SetYc(y)
        dim.SetRadius(radius); dim.SetAngle(35.)
        require(dim.Update(), "Radius Update")
        drive(dim, f"p{index}_c{j}_r", radius)
    require(sketch.EndEdit(), "EndEdit")
    require(sketch.GetConstraintsState() == c.ksStateWellConstrained, "Underdefined sketch")
    depth = spec["depth"]
    require(math.isfinite(depth) and depth != 0, "Invalid signed depth")
    normal = depth > 0
    operation = require(model.GetExtrusions().Add(c3d.o3d_bossExtrusion), "Extrusion")
    operation.SetProfiles([sketch])
    operation.SetDirection(c3d.dtNormal if normal else c3d.dtReverse)
    require(operation.SetSideParameters(normal, c3d.etBlind, abs(depth), 0., False, None), "Depth")
    require(operation.Update(), "Extrusion Update")
    require(not ksapi.IFeature(operation).GetObjectError(), "Extrusion error")
    return sketch


def build(spec: dict[str, Any], output: Path | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if output is not None:
        require(not output.exists() and not output.is_symlink(), "Output exists")
    app = require(ksapi.GetKompas(), "No existing CAD session")
    previous = app.GetActiveDocument()
    doc = require(app.GetDocuments().AddWithDefaultSettings(c.ksDocumentPart, True), "New part")
    # No cleanup after an interrupted/failed native call: session outcome is unknown.
    try:
        part = require(ksapi.IKompasDocument3D(doc).GetTopPart(), "Part")
        model = require(part.GetModelContainer(), "Model")
        sketches = [profile(part, model, item, i) for i, item in enumerate(spec["profiles"])]
        require(part.RebuildModel(True), "Rebuild")
        bodies = ksapi.IFeature(part).GetResultBodies()
        require(len(bodies) == 1 and bodies[0].IsSolid(), "Expected one solid")
        raw = bodies[0].GetGabarit(0., 0., 0., 0., 0., 0.)
        require(raw[0], "Bounds status")
        bounds = list(raw[1:])
        require(all(abs(a - b) < 1e-5 for a, b in zip(bounds, spec["bounds"])),
                f"Signed bounds {bounds} != {spec['bounds']}")
        mass = require(ksapi.IMassInertiaParam(part), "Mass")
        mass.SetLengthUnits(c.ksLUnMM)
        require(mass.Calculate(), "Mass calculation")
        volume = mass.GetVolume()
        require(abs(volume - spec["volume"]) < .5, f"Volume {volume}")
        require(all(s.GetConstraintsState() == c.ksStateWellConstrained for s in sketches), "Sketch state")
        if output is not None:
            require(not output.exists() and not output.is_symlink(), "Output exists before save")
            require(doc.SaveAs(str(output)), "SaveAs")
            require(output.is_file() and output.stat().st_size > 0, "Missing output")
        result = {"bounds": bounds, "volume": volume, "sketches": len(sketches)}
    except BaseException:
        # Preserve stage/traceback and suspect document rather than further API calls.
        raise
    require(doc.Close(c.kdDoNotSaveChanges), "Close own document")
    if previous:
        previous.SetActive()
    return result


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--spec", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--qualify", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.qualify:
        for plane, sign in (("XOY", 1), ("XOY", -1), ("XOZ", 1), ("XOZ", -1)):
            low, high = sorted([0., sign * 6.])
            bounds = ([0., 0., low, 43., 27., high] if plane == "XOY" else
                      [0., low, -27., 43., high, 0.])
            spec = {"profiles": [{"plane": plane, "vertices": [[0, 0], [43, 0], [43, 27], [0, 27]],
                                  "circles": [[11, 9, 3.5]], "depth": sign * 6}],
                    "bounds": bounds, "volume": (43 * 27 - math.pi * 3.5 ** 2) * 6}
            print(json.dumps({"plane": plane, "sign": sign, **build(spec, None)}), flush=True)
        spec = {"profiles": [
            {"plane": "XOZ", "vertices": [[0, 0], [47, 0], [47, -19], [0, -19]],
             "circles": [[13, -8, 2.5]], "depth": -17},
            {"plane": "XOZ", "vertices": [[0, -19], [35, -19], [35, -26], [22, -26],
                                             [22, -39], [9, -39], [9, -53], [0, -53]], "depth": -11}],
                "bounds": [0, -17, 0, 47, 0, 53],
                "volume": (47 * 19 - math.pi * 2.5 ** 2) * 17 + (35 * 7 + 22 * 13 + 9 * 14) * 11}
        print(json.dumps({"qualification": "two signed profiles and negative local coordinates",
                          **build(spec, None)}), flush=True)
    else:
        spec = json.loads(args.spec.read_text()) if args.spec else SPEC
        require(spec, "Set SPEC or pass --spec")
        require(args.output, "Pass --output")
        print(json.dumps(build(spec, args.output.resolve())), flush=True)

# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.11"
# dependencies = []
# ///
"""Practice Problem 1.1 - stepped block with through hole.

Origin at the left/front/bottom corner of the base block (red marker).
Front view: X right, Z up.  Top view: X right, Y away from viewer.
Positive Y points away from the viewer, so the exposed ledge of the base
top face (depth 8) lies at Y = 0..8 and the stacked steps occupy Y = 8..28.

Signed material intervals (mm):
  base   X 0..60  Y 0..28  Z  0..30   with O12 through hole along Y at (44, 16)
  step 1 X 0..48  Y 8..28  Z 30..38
  step 2 X 0..32  Y 8..28  Z 38..50
  column X 0..20  Y 8..28  Z 50..75

All four profiles are XOY rectangles extruded in +Z; the union is exact
because every upper footprint is contained in the base footprint.
Bounding box is asymmetric in X and Z (0..60, 0..28, 0..75).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import ksapi
from constants import constants as c
from constants3d import constants as c3d

SPEC: dict[str, Any] = {
    "profiles": [
        {
            "name": "Base 60x28x30",
            "plane": "XOY",
            "vertices": [[0, 0], [60, 0], [60, 28], [0, 28]],
            "circles": [[44, 16, 6]],
            "depth": 30,
        },
        {
            "name": "Step 48 wide to Z38",
            "plane": "XOY",
            "vertices": [[0, 8], [48, 8], [48, 28], [0, 28]],
            "depth": 38,
        },
        {
            "name": "Step 32 wide to Z50",
            "plane": "XOY",
            "vertices": [[0, 8], [32, 8], [32, 28], [0, 28]],
            "depth": 50,
        },
        {
            "name": "Column 20 wide to Z75",
            "plane": "XOY",
            "vertices": [[0, 8], [20, 8], [20, 28], [0, 28]],
            "depth": 75,
        },
    ],
    "bounds": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 60.0, 28.0, 75.0],
    "volume": 72593.27460518149,
}


def require(value: Any, label: str) -> Any:
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError(label)
    return value


def constraint(obj: Any, kind: int, **values: Any) -> None:
    item = require(obj.NewConstraint(), "NewConstraint")
    item.SetConstraintType(kind)
    for key, value in values.items():
        getattr(item, "Set" + key)(value)
    require(item.Create() and item.IsValid(), f"Constraint {kind}")


def drive(dim: Any, name: str, value: float) -> None:
    constraint(dim, c.ksCFixedDim)
    constraint(dim, c.ksCDimWithVariable, Variable=name, ConstraintValue=value)


def length(symbols: Any, p: list[float], q: list[float], horizontal: bool,
           name: str) -> None:
    axis = 0 if horizontal else 1
    value = abs(q[axis] - p[axis])
    require(value > 1e-7, "Zero driving dimension")
    dim = require(symbols.GetLineDimensions().Add(), "Dimension")
    dim.SetX1(p[0]); dim.SetY1(p[1])
    dim.SetX2(q[0]); dim.SetY2(q[1])
    dim.SetX3((p[0] + q[0]) / 2 + (0 if horizontal else -7))
    dim.SetY3((p[1] + q[1]) / 2 + (-7 if horizontal else 0))
    dim.SetOrientation(c.ksLinDHorizontal if horizontal else c.ksLinDVertical)
    require(dim.Update() and dim.Associate(), f"Dimension association {name}")
    drive(dim, name, value)


def profile(part: Any, model: Any, spec: dict[str, Any], index: int) -> Any:
    points = spec["vertices"]
    require(len(points) >= 4, "Polygon needs four vertices")
    edges = list(zip(points, points[1:] + points[:1]))
    directions = []
    for p, q in edges:
        dx, dy = q[0] - p[0], q[1] - p[1]
        require((abs(dx) < 1e-9) != (abs(dy) < 1e-9), "Nonorthogonal or zero edge")
        directions.append(abs(dy) < 1e-9)
    require(all(directions[i] != directions[(i + 1) % len(edges)]
                for i in range(len(edges))), "Merge adjacent collinear edges first")
    plane = {"XOY": c3d.o3d_planeXOY, "XOZ": c3d.o3d_planeXOZ}[spec["plane"]]
    sketch = require(model.GetSketchs().Add(), "Sketch")
    sketch.SetName(spec.get("name", f"Profile {index}"))
    sketch.SetPlane(require(part.GetDefaultObject(plane), "Plane"))
    require(sketch.Update(), "Sketch Update")
    fragment = require(sketch.BeginEdit(False), "BeginEdit")
    fragment.SetParametricMode(True)
    view = require(fragment.GetViewsAndLayersManager().GetViews().GetActiveView(), "View")
    drawing, symbols = ksapi.IDrawingContainer(view), ksapi.ISymbols2DContainer(view)
    lines = []
    for p, q in edges:
        line = require(drawing.GetLineSegments().Add(), "Line")
        line.SetX1(p[0]); line.SetY1(p[1]); line.SetX2(q[0]); line.SetY2(q[1])
        require(line.Update(), "Line Update")
        lines.append(line)
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        constraint(line, c.ksCMergePoints, Partners=[lines[(i + 1) % len(lines)]],
                   Index=1, PartnerIndex=0)
        constraint(line, c.ksCHorizontal if directions[i] else c.ksCVertical)
    constraint(lines[0], c.ksCFixedPoint, Index=0)
    # Closure supplies the last horizontal and vertical lengths: do not overconstrain.
    skip = {max(i for i, h in enumerate(directions) if h),
            max(i for i, h in enumerate(directions) if not h)}
    for i, (p, q) in enumerate(edges):
        if i not in skip:
            length(symbols, p, q, directions[i], f"p{index}_e{i}")
    for j, (x, y, radius) in enumerate(spec.get("circles", [])):
        circle = require(drawing.GetCircles().Add(), "Circle")
        circle.SetXc(x); circle.SetYc(y); circle.SetRadius(radius)
        require(circle.Update(), "Circle Update")
        length(symbols, points[0], [x, y], True, f"p{index}_c{j}_x")
        length(symbols, points[0], [x, y], False, f"p{index}_c{j}_y")
        dim = require(symbols.GetRadialDimensions().Add(), "Radius")
        dim.SetBaseObject(circle); dim.SetXc(x); dim.SetYc(y)
        dim.SetRadius(radius); dim.SetAngle(35.)
        require(dim.Update(), "Radius Update")
        drive(dim, f"p{index}_c{j}_r", radius)
    require(sketch.EndEdit(), "EndEdit")
    require(sketch.GetConstraintsState() == c.ksStateWellConstrained, "Underdefined sketch")
    depth = spec["depth"]
    require(math.isfinite(depth) and depth != 0, "Invalid signed depth")
    normal = depth > 0
    operation = require(model.GetExtrusions().Add(c3d.o3d_bossExtrusion), "Extrusion")
    operation.SetProfiles([sketch])
    operation.SetDirection(c3d.dtNormal if normal else c3d.dtReverse)
    require(operation.SetSideParameters(normal, c3d.etBlind, abs(depth), 0., False, None), "Depth")
    require(operation.Update(), "Extrusion Update")
    require(not ksapi.IFeature(operation).GetObjectError(), "Extrusion error")
    return sketch


def build(spec: dict[str, Any], output: Path | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if output is not None:
        require(not output.exists() and not output.is_symlink(), "Output exists")
    app = require(ksapi.GetKompas(), "No existing CAD session")
    previous = app.GetActiveDocument()
    doc = require(app.GetDocuments().AddWithDefaultSettings(c.ksDocumentPart, True), "New part")
    # No cleanup after an interrupted/failed native call: session outcome is unknown.
    try:
        part = require(ksapi.IKompasDocument3D(doc).GetTopPart(), "Part")
        model = require(part.GetModelContainer(), "Model")
        sketches = [profile(part, model, item, i) for i, item in enumerate(spec["profiles"])]
        require(part.RebuildModel(True), "Rebuild")
        bodies = ksapi.IFeature(part).GetResultBodies()
        require(len(bodies) == 1 and bodies[0].IsSolid(), "Expected one solid")
        raw = bodies[0].GetGabarit(0., 0., 0., 0., 0., 0.)
        require(raw[0], "Bounds status")
        bounds = list(raw[1:])
        require(all(abs(a - b) < 1e-5 for a, b in zip(bounds, spec["bounds"])),
                f"Signed bounds {bounds} != {spec['bounds']}")
        mass = require(ksapi.IMassInertiaParam(part), "Mass")
        mass.SetLengthUnits(c.ksLUnMM)
        require(mass.Calculate(), "Mass calculation")
        volume = mass.GetVolume()
        require(abs(volume - spec["volume"]) < .5, f"Volume {volume}")
        require(all(s.GetConstraintsState() == c.ksStateWellConstrained for s in sketches), "Sketch state")
        if output is not None:
            require(not output.exists() and not output.is_symlink(), "Output exists before save")
            require(doc.SaveAs(str(output)), "SaveAs")
            require(output.is_file() and output.stat().st_size > 0, "Missing output")
        result = {"bounds": bounds, "volume": volume, "sketches": len(sketches)}
    except BaseException:
        # Preserve stage/traceback and suspect document rather than further API calls.
        raise
    require(doc.Close(c.kdDoNotSaveChanges), "Close own document")
    if previous:
        previous.SetActive()
    return result


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--spec", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--qualify", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.qualify:
        raise SystemExit("qualification not used for this task")
    spec = json.loads(args.spec.read_text()) if args.spec else SPEC
    require(spec, "Set SPEC or pass --spec")
    require(args.output, "Pass --output")
    print(json.dumps(build(spec, args.output.resolve())), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Right — the hole at X=44, r=6 spans X 38..50, and step1 spans X 0..48. So step1 fills the hole over X 38..48 for Z 30..38 — but the hole is only Z 10..22, so no overlap in Z... The base hole is Z 10..22, and step1 spans Z 0..38 at Y 8..28. That DOES overlap the hole volume for Y 8..28, X 38..48, Z 10..22.

That's the bug: the step extrusions start at Z=0 and pass through the base, and step1's X extent (0..48) intersects the bore. In reality the steps sit ON TOP of the base (Z ≥ 30) and don't pass through it.

Fix: extrude the steps from Z=30 upward. Since the XOY plane is at Z=0, I must offset. The simplest robust fix: make steps start at Z=30 by sketching them on an offset plane, or give them their own contour that starts at Z=30... The recipe has no plane offset support.

Alternative approach that avoids plane offsets entirely: extrude each step from Z=0 but choose a *through-all* start by using a "up to surface"? Not supported.

Better structural approach: build the ENTIRE part as a single XOZ profile (the front-view staircase silhouette) extruded along Y for the full 28, plus the bore; then the ledge requires the upper region be only Y 8..28, which a single XOZ profile can't express. So I need two XOZ profiles:
- Ledge/base: XOZ rect X 0..60, Z 0..30, depth 28 (full Y) with the bore → base with hole.
- Upper staircase: XOZ staircase silhouette (X 0..20 up to 75, 0..32 to 50, 0..48 to 38, 0..60 to 30) extruded along Y **only 8..28**. Its Z starts at 30 ≤ base top, and where it overlaps the base (Z 0..30 region, X..) it would again fill the bore at Y 8..28.

To avoid the bore overlap, make the upper staircase profile start exactly at Z=30 (v = -30) and go up. Then it never enters the bore region (bore Z 10..22).

- Profile B (XOZ): staircase from Z=30 up: vertices (0,-30),(20,-30),(20,-75),(0,-75) — plus the wider steps... A single polygon must be a simple orthogonal staircase:

  That's the front-view upper silhouette. But it must be extruded only over Y 8..28, which again needs a plane offset.

Cleanest within the recipe: split each step extrusion into an XOY profile that starts above the bore and doesn't cross it... not possible without a plane offset.

def build(part: ksapi.IPart, model: ksapi.IModelContainer) -> None:
    auxiliary = require(ksapi.IAuxiliaryGeomContainer(part), "Auxiliary geometry")
    plane = require(auxiliary.GetPlanes3D().Add(c3d.o3d_planeOffset), "Offset plane")
    offset = require(ksapi.IPlane3DByOffset(plane), "Offset-plane interface")
    offset.SetBasePlane(require(part.GetDefaultObject(c3d.o3d_planeXOY), "XOY plane"))
    offset.SetOffset(15.0)
    offset.SetDirection(True)
    require(offset.Update(), "Offset plane at Z=15")
    with edit_sketch(model, plane) as (profile, drawing):
        circle = require(drawing.GetCircles().Add(), "Circle")
        circle.SetXc(0.0)
        circle.SetYc(0.0)
        circle.SetRadius(5.0)
        require(circle.Update(), "Circle geometry")

    extrusion = require(model.GetExtrusions().Add(c3d.o3d_bossExtrusion), "Extrusion")
    extrusion.SetProfiles([profile])
    extrusion.SetDirection(c3d.dtNormal)
    require(extrusion.SetSideParameters(True, c3d.etBlind, 5.0, 0.0, False, None), "Depth")
    require(extrusion.Update(), "Build cylinder")


def validate(part: ksapi.IPart) -> Bounds:
    require(part.RebuildModel(True), "Rebuild part")
    root = require(ksapi.IFeature(part), "Part feature")
    errors, seen = [], set()

    def visit(feature: ksapi.IFeature, path: Sequence[str]) -> None:
        if feature.reference in seen:
            return
        seen.add(feature.reference)
        path = [*path, feature.GetName()]
        error = feature.GetObjectError()
        if error:
            errors.append((path, error))
        for child in feature.GetSubFeatures(c.ksOperTree, True, True):
            if child:
                visit(child, path)

    visit(root, [])
    require(not errors, f"Operation tree errors: {errors}")
    bodies = root.GetResultBodies()
    require(len(bodies) == 1, f"Expected one body, got {len(bodies)}")
    require(bodies[0].IsSolid(), "Result is not solid")
    result = bodies[0].GetGabarit(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    require(result[0] and len(result) == 7, "Body bounds")
    bounds = tuple(result[1:])
    require(all(math.isfinite(a) and abs(a - b) <= 1e-5
                for a, b in zip(bounds, EXPECTED)), f"Unexpected bounds: {bounds}")
    return bounds


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, help="Save a new .m3d file after validation")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    output = args.output.expanduser().absolute() if args.output else None
    if output is not None and (output.exists() or output.is_symlink()):
        parser.error(f"Output already exists: {output}")

    app = require(ksapi.GetKompas(), "No existing KOMPAS API session")
    previous = app.GetActiveDocument()
    owned = []
    try:
        doc, part, model = new_part(app, owned)
        build(part, model)
        bounds = validate(part)
        if output is not None:
            if output.exists() or output.is_symlink():
                raise FileExistsError(output)
            output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            require(doc.SaveAs(str(output)), "Save part")
            require(output.is_file() and output.stat().st_size > 0, "Missing or empty output")
    finally:
        try:
            for doc in reversed(owned):
                require(doc.Close(c.kdDoNotSaveChanges), "Close owned part")
        finally:
            if previous:
                previous.SetActive()
    print(f"Success: 1 solid; bounds={bounds}; output={output or '(not saved)'}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
